caption: The drawing depicts an old-fashioned, manually operated fire engine with a predominantly reddish-brown wooden body, mounted on two large spoked wheels of the same color and a smaller, thinner wheel in the back connected by a long red handle. A central rectangular tank labeled "VETERAN" in yellow letters and marked with a gold "2" is situated above the main body. Two metal cylinders, likely water pumping mechanisms, run horizontally along the sides. There are ornamental black wrought iron railings and structures, including decorative curls and gold-colored finials on the top, three on each side. A gold-colored bell sits on top of the structure. Black handrails or levers extend from the sides and front, presumably used to operate the machine. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Hand Powered Fire Pump
